_comment: Live audit 2026-11-03 (F3): an embed of a FILE the vault does not hold is the live lane's not-found notice, `<name> wasn't found in the vault.`, on both lanes, named as the member wrote it (a width, an anchor and a folder off). The plugin sends each as a `missing` ref whose path is the name as written (Plan C Task 8 `classifyRef`). An embed of a missing NOTE keeps D2 item 8: the note's name as text (a pending link on the server, plain text on the client); the plugin sends no ref for a note.
